artworks.title: Apollo and Marsyas
artworks.description: The image shows a male figure standing at the center with one hand raised and holding an object, while the other hand holds a large sword-like weapon. He has classical facial features, long hair with a leafy garland, and is almost nude with a drapery hanging from his waist. Various characters and elements of nature surround him, with muscular, armored men on the left and a struggling figure on the right. The background includes trees, a landscape, mountains, and a castle-like structure on the horizon. The scene is detailed with symbolic elements, typical of mythological and allegorical engravings.

artworks.title: Erasmus of Rotterdam
artworks.artist: Frans Huys after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting at a desk with various objects like an open book, a quill in an ink pot, a folded letter, and an hourglass. A decorated book titled "BIBLIA" is seen on the desk. In the background, there is a window showing a medieval town with a river, boats, and church towers. Inscriptions in Latin are on the wall.

artworks.title: Frederic Sylvester Douglas
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a man's body in a three-quarter view. He is turned slightly to his left with a composed expression. His facial features are detailed, including sharp eyes and a prominent nose, and he has short, curly hair. The man is dressed in a formal outfit typical of the early 19th century, consisting of a high-collared shirt with a cravat, a waistcoat, and a jacket. There are no visible jewelry or objects on him. The background is plain, emphasizing the subject. Below the drawing, the name "The Hon[ora]ble Frederic Sylvester North Douglas," along with the years of birth and death, the artist's signature, and the date "1815" are inscribed.

artworks.title: Saint John on Patmos
artworks.description: The image shows a monochrome landscape with tall trees on the left, a townscape in the middle leading to distant mountains. On the right, there is a seated figure near a rock formation overlooking a water body with a horizontal horizon line. The water has a windmill and buildings along the shore. The sky has flowing clouds depicted with curved lines. The artwork showcases a range of textures and details, combining intricate elements with expansive vistas in grayscale.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Bacchus
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a Bacchanalian procession scene. The drawing includes a detailed chariot pulled by horses, surrounded by figures like satyrs and nymphs carrying musical instruments and festive items. The artwork is filled with twisting bodies and decorative elements, illustrating movement and energy typical of Bacchanalian scenes.

artworks.title: Lawyer Wade
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, seated at a table or desk. His body is angled slightly to the right as he leans forward. He has detailed facial features, a mustache, a prominent nose, and short, neatly combed back hair. He wears a dark suit with a formal collar. The man is holding a pen in his right hand, poised over a piece of paper. The background consists of dark, cross-hatching lines that suggest shadow and depth, with objects like a chair or writing desk behind him, indicating an indoor setting.

artworks.title: Prudence
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 10.7 x 8.1 cm (4 3/16 x 3 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological figure with a lion and a dragon. The central figure is depicted in a classical style, with long flowing hair and draped in fabric as she sits on a rock. A lion sits to her left, while a dragon is positioned on her right. The figure is holding an object in her left hand and her right hand is near the dragon. The drawing features careful detailing and evokes a sense of antiquity and myth.

artworks.title: The Hat Pin (Le chapeau epingle)
artworks.description: The image shows a partial view of a person's upper body, focusing on the head and shoulders. The person is positioned slightly to the side, with their face oriented toward the right edge of the frame. The sketch captures the person's facial features with closed eyes and slightly parted lips. Their hair is depicted with flowing lines, mostly covered by a large hat with intricate detailing. The individual's clothing appears simple with soft folds, and their hand is resting against their face. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects being held. The background of the image contains abstract swirling and shading patterns, contrasting with the figure in the center of the composition.

artworks.title: The Two Bathers (Les deux baigneuses)
artworks.description: Two women are depicted in the image. One woman is sitting on the left, looking down and adjusting a large hat with a flower decoration. The other woman is crouched on the right, looking at her foot. They are both dressed in loose garments and surrounded by grass or foliage.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome Hearing the Trumpet of the Last Judgment
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper (with offset of unidentified print of Saint Anthony of Padua, surrounded by scenes from his life, on verso)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elderly man reclining and gazing upwards towards a celestial figure. The man rests on a pile of books and is draped in a cloth. Surrounding him are objects like a skull, a lion's head carving, and more books. Above him, on a cloud, is an angelic figure with wings and a trumpet. The image has a contemplative tone as the earthly and ethereal elements interact in a classical composition.

artworks.title: Adam and Eve with the Infants Cain and Abel
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 25.7 x 17.8 cm (10 1/8 x 7 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two adult figures and two children in the foreground. The figure on the left holds a stick, while the figure beside them holds a child. One child is seated on a grassy area. The setting includes a rural landscape with water, foliage, and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Head of the Executioner
artworks.artist: Prince Rupert of the Pfalz after Jusepe de Ribera
artworks.medium: mezzotint with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a profile view of a man's head and upper shoulders. He is facing to the right with the side of his face visible, showing distinct facial features including a nose, beard, and mustache. His hair is covered by a headscarf or turban that is tied at the back. The man is wearing a draped garment. There are no visible accessories or objects. The background is a dark, textured surface that contrasts with the man's lighter face and clothing, emphasizing the subject.

artworks.title: Ecce Homo
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man standing before a group of others in a historical setting. The central figure is wearing a crown of thorns and a long robe. The people surrounding him are clad in historical clothing, some wearing helmets and holding spears. The architecture in the background has arches and stone detailing. A dog is sitting on the ground at the bottom left. Fine lines and detailed shading are used to convey textures and expressions.

artworks.title: A Standing Oriental Wearing a Greatcoat
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a person standing upright. The figure is facing slightly to the right with both arms down. The right hand is holding an object that appears to be a cup or a small container. The individual has a long beard, a partially shadowed face, and is wearing headgear that suggests a cap or hat. They are dressed in a long coat with buttons, possibly a robe, extending below the knees and draping over both shoulders. The feet are visible below the hem of the garment. The background is a plain, empty space without additional details or objects, focusing on the individual.

artworks.title: A Standing Oriental Holding a Rod
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person standing upright. The person has a long beard and is wearing a rounded hat and draped clothing that flows down to their feet. Their facial features are not distinctly drawn, but the outline suggests elongated features beneath the hat. The clothing is loose, with a shawl or cloak draped over the shoulders and long sleeves. The figure holds a small stick or similar object in one hand. There is no detailed background.

artworks.title: Woman at the Tub (Femme au tub)
artworks.medium: color lithograph on wove paper [trial proof]
artworks.description: The image features a person pouring liquid from a pitcher into a basin while kneeling. The person's face is not visible, their hair is long and brown, tied back with a red ribbon. They are wearing a long dark garment with puffed sleeves and light-colored cuffs. Other elements in the image include a fireplace or stove, a small decorative object on top, a red-patterned rug on the floor, and walls with decorative elements and what appears to be a window or a door frame.

artworks.title: Guy and Mealy in "Paris qui marche" (Guy et Mealy dans "Paris qui marche")
artworks.medium: lithograph in violet-brown on Japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures from the waist up. The figure on the left stands upright with one arm raised, while the figure on the right leans slightly to the left. The facial features are softly sketched, with the left person in profile, showing a prominent nose and high hairstyle. The right person's hair is adorned with what appears to be feathers or a headdress. Both figures wear ornate clothing; the right figure's garment has noticeable patterns or embellishments on the shoulders. The left person's attire is less detailed, with what looks like ruffled or layered fabric. They hold a round, reflective object. The background consists of vertical lines and shading.

artworks.title: Lender Bowing (Lender saluant)
artworks.medium: lithograph in olive green on velin paper
artworks.description: The image features a partial figure of a woman shown from the waist up, positioned in profile with her head slightly bowed. Her facial features are delicately defined, with a prominent nose and lips, and her hair is styled upward in an elaborate fashion atop her head. She is dressed in a garment with visible patterns, characterized by flowing lines and textures. Behind her are two other figures depicted in a somewhat ghostly manner; one appears to wear a crown and the other a feathered cap. The background is sketchy and abstract.

artworks.title: Rejane and Galipaux in "Madame Sans-Gêne" (Réjane et Galipaux dans "Madame Sans-Gêne")
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: The sketch depicts three individuals with their full bodies visible. Two of the characters are prominently positioned at the foreground, engaged in a scene. The person on the left is a woman wearing a fitted dress with puffed sleeves and a hat adorned with a feather. The man on the right is holding her hand and dressed in formal attire with a ruffled shirt. The woman's face is drawn with exaggerated features, and her hair is styled neatly under her hat. The man has a balding head and exaggerated facial features as well. Behind them, another man is drawn faintly wearing a suit. The background consists of simple vertical lines.

artworks.title: Apuleia in Search of Apuleius
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral landscape with a central bridge in the distance. Rolling hills dominate the horizon, with detailed brushwork showing figures, animals, trees, and architecture in a monochromatic sepia color palette.

artworks.title: Chain of Alps from Grenoble to Chamberi
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated point, stretching out across a wide valley. The horizon is positioned above the middle of the composition, where the land meets the sky. Distant mountains can be seen beyond the horizon. In the foreground, there are figures engaging in activities near some vegetation. The scene is depicted in a monochromatic sepia-tone color palette, resembling an etching or ink drawing. The lines are fine and intricate, capturing the landscape's detail accurately. The vegetation transitions into open fields in the distance, gradually becoming less detailed towards the horizon.

artworks.title: Isis
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a scenic view taken from a slightly elevated angle. In the foreground, there is detailed foliage and greenery, with a leafy plant and a smaller plant with cascading leaves. Behind the greenery, there are architectural elements including a circular structure with grand columns and a richly decorated rectangular structure. In the background, there is a line of trees against an open sky. The image is rendered using fine linework and a monochromatic palette with subtle variations in ink.

artworks.title: Isleworth
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape from an elevated viewpoint, showing a view including classical architectural elements like a round, columned structure resembling a temple. Surrounding the temple are detailed trees, depicted in fine lines similar to an etching technique. The monochrome color palette features shades of sepia. The scene includes lush vegetation and a calm body of water reflecting the trees and temple. In the background, faint architectural elements are suggested, becoming less defined towards the horizon.

artworks.title: London from Greenwich
artworks.description: The viewpoint is elevated, overlooking a landscape sloping down to reveal a detailed architectural scene. The horizon is high, showing a sprawling cityscape with ships docked along the waterline. Prominent buildings with domes and classical features are in the center, framed by trees. The illustration has precise pen work, depicting natural elements and buildings with fine lines. The color palette is monochrome, varying shades of light brown. Sheep are grazing on a grassy hillside, with a detailed urban and maritime panorama extending into the distance.
